description: Monthly net freight excluding the fuel surcharge written into a named summary CSV for a depot lane. WORKBANK-CANARY-2c8f4a60

files.README.md:
# Southgate Cargo - Harwell depot lane

invoices_may_2026.csv is the carrier's invoice for the Harwell depot lane
for May 2026, one line per consignment. base_freight is the carriage
charge before the fuel surcharge; fuel_surcharge is the surcharge added on
top; total_charge is the all-in figure the carrier bills for the line.
Charges are in GBP.

turns.prompt: Southgate Cargo has sent its May 2026 lane invoice for the Harwell depot, and it is in the workspace. Create reports/freight_summary.csv holding a header line and a single data row: the header must read 'metric,value', and the row must place net_freight in the first field and, in the second, the month's net freight for the lane - the carriage charges before the fuel surcharge is added. Write the amount as a plain decimal with two decimal places and no thousands separators. When finished, reply DONE.
